title: A Balance of Iron and Salt

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The story keeps bodily survival and legal standing in the same conversation.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its domestic scenes make technical categories feel incomplete without becoming meaningless.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Naming the relationship becomes another way to distribute power inside the household.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: This future has pipes, reserves, maintenance failures, and bodies needing water.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Those details prevent political language from floating above its consequences.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: A declaration changes meaning when families cannot reach what they need.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: A system's absence reveals the work its ordinary competence had concealed.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Later chapters put competing accounts under increasing practical and moral pressure.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The city's physical instability gives institutional disagreement a frightening bodily scale.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its machinery makes the arguments answerable to people who cannot escape them.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The book continues beyond the excitement of a single emergency.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: It asks how people account for choices made with defensible intentions.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its institutions preserve reasons, while families must live with their effects.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: That difference gives the aftermath space to complicate earlier judgments.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Readers who enjoy political science fiction will find difficult household stakes.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Readers drawn to family stories will encounter systems inside intimate decisions.
